industry.why: Neutral, carried, with the disagreement stated: relative strength A (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; A prior) and Logistics B, so the market is buying freight, while the 27-Nov-26 regime (risk-off in the open) is not what a cyclical, freight-exposed industry is paid for over twelve months; no source spoke to transport this week. Nine Pool names here (Kuehne + Nagel, Maersk, Wallenius Wilhelmsen, Hoegh Autoliners, CMB.TECH, NORDEN, Posti, Irish Continental, Wilhelmsen), let through on merit, where their bottom-up grades are the obstacle. Counter-case for higher: three readings at A; for lower: freight is the first casualty if the growth data turn.

sector.why: Neutral, carried, with the disagreement stated: relative strength B (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; A prior), the market buying freight, against a regime that does not pay cyclical freight over twelve months; no source spoke to logistics this week. Nine Pool names let through on merit, where their bottom-up grades are the obstacle (Kuehne + Nagel 27.0, Maersk 12.0, Wallenius Wilhelmsen 23.0 on the Bottom-up composite). Counter-case for higher: three readings at A or B; for lower: freight is the first casualty if the growth data turn.
